title: 8.2 Stem-and-Leaf Plots

icans: I can make a stem-and-leaf plot.
I can use a stem-and-leaf plot to find measures of center and spread.
I can describe the shape of a distribution as symmetric, skewed left, or skewed right.

vocab: a display that uses the digits of the data values to ___________ them; the leaves are in order
every digit __________ the last (for 2-digit data, the tens digit)
a __________ that shows what a stem and leaf mean, such as 3 | 4 = 34
the left and right sides of the __________ are about mirror images
most data on the left, with a tail _____________ to the right (larger values)
most data on the right, with a tail _____________ to the left (smaller values)
